result:
The hook is defined in the framework repo, and the patient chart uses it directly in two workspace forms. Both forms pass the controller into save/fetch calls, so a change to its abort-on-unmount or regenerate-if-aborted behaviour would reach them. Chart code that uses SWR through `useOpenmrsSWR` (which also calls the hook) would be affected indirectly; I did not enumerate those callers.

**Direct use in the patient chart**

- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-vitals-app/src/vitals-biometrics-form/exported-vitals-biometrics-form.workspace.tsx:87`: creates the controller and passes it to `createOrUpdateVitalsAndBiometrics` in the save handler (lines 225–267).
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-orders-app/src/lab-results/exported-lab-results-form.workspace.tsx:70`: creates the controller and passes it to `fetchSavedLabResults` (line 254), `completeOrderWithSavedResults` (line 304) and `updateOrderResult` (line 338).

**Framework definition and internal use (openmrs-esm-core)**

- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-react-utils/src/useAbortController.ts:25`: the hook itself. It makes a new controller when none exists or the current one is aborted, and aborts on unmount.
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-react-utils/src/useOpenmrsSWR.ts:72`: calls the hook for SWR fetches, so chart code using `useOpenmrsSWR` depends on it.
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/apps/esm-primary-navigation-app/src/components/change-language/change-language.modal.tsx:33`: another framework consumer, outside the chart.

**Mocks and tests (would need updating alongside any behaviour change)**

- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-react-utils/src/useAbortController.test.tsx:6`: unit tests for the hook.
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-react-utils/mock.tsx:108` and `mock-jest.tsx:103`: test doubles for the hook.

I could not read `useOpenmrsSWR.ts` beyond the call site, so the remaining chart SWR consumers are not listed. The `useOpenmrsSWR` range is the call-site line only.
